headline: Claude Fable 5 emerges as physical AI contender against GPT-5.6
body: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 is now being directly compared to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 in physical AI applications, with multiple sources evaluating which model performs better for robotics and embodied AI tasks. This benchmark comparison matters for healthcare because physical AI capabilities will increasingly underpin robotic surgery platforms, autonomous laboratory systems, and robotic process automation in clinical workflows. Healthcare organizations and AI vendors evaluating multimodal models for surgical planning or lab automation now have comparative performance data to inform procurement and integration decisions. The velocity of coverage around Claude's capabilities suggests healthcare CIOs should monitor these frontier model releases for potential clinical workflow optimization opportunities.
